title: Console Setup › Apps: "Set as default" on a read-only app clears the current default before its own write is refused, leaving no default app
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

## What happens
Making an app in a read-only package the default first unsets the current default. The second write is then refused, and nothing rolls back, so the deployment is left with no default app.

## Reproduction
Reproduced twice on fresh loads at `6091b645`.
1. Boot a fresh showcase and sign the admin in through the form.
2. Make an app in a writable package the default. Here that was `mthree_app` in `com.objectstack.qa.mthree`, published with `isDefault:true`.
3. Open `/_console/system/apps` and click "Set Showcase as default" on the Showcase row (package `com.example.showcase`, read-only).
4. The page sends two writes, in this order:
   - `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/mthree_app?package=com.objectstack.qa.mthree` with `isDefault:false` → 200.
   - `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/showcase_app?package=com.example.showcase` with `isDefault:true` → 403 "Cannot overlay 'app' in package 'com.example.showcase': that package is read-only…".
5. A toast says "Failed to set default app".
6. After a reload, `GET /api/v1/meta/app` lists no app with `isDefault:true` (before: `["mthree_app"]`), and the next sign-in lands on `/_console/home`.

## Mechanism
`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx` (around line 387) unsets the previous default (`saveApp(meta, prev, { ...prev, isDefault: false })`) before it saves the new one, and does not roll back when the second save is refused. This is the app twin of #33098, which fixed the same thing for list views.

## Expected
A refused set-default leaves `/meta/app` unchanged. Either write the new default first, or refuse a locked target before any write.

QA-source: #34859 · platform-core.app-management-toggle · acceptance[5]
